name: jc-skills
description: Autonomous full-lifecycle SDLC multi-agent framework for Google Antigravity with 17 specialized skills, deterministic state tracking, and quality gates.
author: JC

A.name: Project Setup
A.description: Executed once per greenfield project to bootstrap architecture, toolchain, structure, and CI.

B.name: Per-Story Iterative Loop
B.description: Repeated for each user story with BDD, API contracts, deep specs, implementation, security, QA, SRE, and acceptance sign-off.

C.name: Project Delivery & Release
C.description: Compiles developer portal, API docs, operational runbooks, and provisions production IaC/CI-CD.

governance.name: Autonomous Governance & Orchestration
governance.description: Governs the per-story SDLC lifecycle and state tracking across all skills.

skills.name: jc.orchestrator
skills.description: Autonomous Pipeline Conductor and Project Governance Specialist.

skills.name: jc.product-owner
skills.description: Agile Product Owner and Business Strategist. Maps user journeys, backlogs, and NFRs.

skills.name: jc.project-structure
skills.description: Lead Software Architect. Defines tech stack, ADR-001, RBAC roles, and project-spec.yml.

skills.name: jc.environment-initializer
skills.description: Toolchain and environment bootstrapping. Sets up virtualenvs, .env, and dev-compose.

skills.name: jc.structure-builder
skills.description: Filesystem scaffolding specialist. Reads project-spec.yml and creates structure.

skills.name: jc.analyst
skills.description: Requirements Analyst. Formulates Gherkin BDD scenarios, NFRs, and conducts sign-off.

skills.name: jc.contract-creator
skills.description: API Contract Specialist. Generates and validates standard JSON API contracts.

skills.name: jc.ai-engineer
skills.description: AI & LLM Systems Architect. Designs generative pipelines, RAG, and vector stores.

skills.name: jc.data-architect
skills.description: Enterprise Data Architect. Designs normalized schemas, indexes, and zero-downtime migrations.

skills.name: jc.ux-ui
skills.description: Design System Architect. Creates Design Tokens, WCAG guidelines, and component states.

skills.name: jc.backend-expert
skills.description: Senior Backend Architect. Builds production-grade APIs, secure logic, and persistence.

skills.name: jc.frontend-expert
skills.description: Senior Frontend Engineer. Builds accessible UI views consuming backend contracts.

skills.name: jc.cybersecurity
skills.description: Security Auditor. Runs SAST, dependency audits, secret scans with zero High/Critical policy.

skills.name: jc.qa-automation
skills.description: Test Automation Engineer. E2E/integration tests, >=80% coverage, axe-core a11y.

skills.name: jc.sre-performance
skills.description: Site Reliability Engineer. Load/stress tests (k6/Locust) and latency SLOs.

skills.name: jc.tech-writer
skills.description: Documentation Architect. ADRs, developer portal, API docs, and runbooks.

skills.name: jc.devops-engineer
skills.description: CI/CD & Cloud Specialist. Early CI workflows, hardened Dockerfiles, and production IaC.
